summary_ja: 内部モデル方式採用最終指定親会社がトレーディング・デスクの要件を満たさない場合の承認の取消しを定める。
summary_en: Allows the Commissioner to revoke the trading desk approval where an internal-model Ultimate Designated Parent Company fails the trading desk requirements.
paragraphs: The Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency may revoke the approval under Article 249-4, paragraph (1) where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal model approach does not satisfy the requirements listed in the items of Article 249-3, paragraph (3).
